titleEs: Last Epoch Discord vs Forum oficial — chat real-time vs archive estructurado
titleEn: Last Epoch Discord vs official forum — real-time chat vs structured archive
descriptionEs: Ambos son first-party EHG. Discord es high-volume, real-time, casual; forum es low-volume, asíncrono, estructurado y archived. Sirven needs distintos del workflow community.
descriptionEn: Both are first-party EHG. Discord is high-volume, real-time, casual; the forum is low-volume, async, structured, and archived. They serve different community workflow needs.
verdictEs: Discord para chat real-time, Q&A rápido, LFG, casual pulse. Forum para dev blogs long-form, bug reports formales, Build Compendium curado, archive permanente searchable. No reemplazan; complementan.
verdictEn: Discord for real-time chat, fast Q&A, LFG, casual pulse. Forum for long-form dev blogs, formal bug reports, curated Build Compendium, permanent searchable archive. They don't replace; they complement.

useCases.reasonEs: Cuando EHG announce algo, el Discord reacciona en minutos. Forum threads cooked durante horas.
useCases.reasonEn: When EHG announces something, Discord reacts in minutes. Forum threads cook over hours.

useCases.reasonEs: Devs publican dev blogs long-form en forum, no en Discord. Para depth de design decisions, forum es ground truth.
useCases.reasonEn: Devs publish long-form dev blogs on the forum, not Discord. For design-decision depth, forum is ground truth.

useCases.reasonEs: Forum tiene bug report templates con fields como repro steps, version, severity. Discord posts se entierran sin tracking.
useCases.reasonEn: Forum has bug-report templates with fields like repro steps, version, severity. Discord posts get buried without tracking.

useCases.reasonEs: Forum pinned thread "Last Epoch Build Compendium" agrega community builds en un solo lugar. Discord no tiene equivalente curated.
useCases.reasonEn: Forum pinned thread "Last Epoch Build Compendium" aggregates community builds in one place. Discord has no curated equivalent.

useCases.reasonEs: Forum threads desde Early Access (2018+) están archived y searchable. Discord es ephemeral.
useCases.reasonEn: Forum threads since Early Access (2018+) are archived and searchable. Discord is ephemeral.
